conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Division. This is Officer Patel speaking. Am I speaking with Mr. Chen?
Yes, this is Chen. I just got a message that there is a problem with my taxes? I am really worried.

Thank you for responding quickly, Mr. Chen. I am reviewing your tax file, and it seems there are significant discrepancies in your reporting from the last two years. The IRS takes these matters extremely seriously.
Discrepancies? I don't understand. I use an accountant. I always try to do everything right.
Unfortunately, our audit found undeclared foreign income and missing forms, which has resulted in a substantial outstanding balance with interest. This is now considered a legal matter.
Wait, legal matter? What happens now? I am on a work visa, this is very scary.

Mr. Chen, if this is not settled immediately, the IRS will be forced to initiate enforcement, this could include a federal lien on your assets, freezing your bank accounts, and notification to immigration services regarding noncompliance.
No, no, please! I cannot lose my visa. What do I need to do?
At this point, to halt the escalation of legal proceedings, you must clear the outstanding balance today. The total due, including penalties and legal fees, is $7,400.32.
That's so much, I don't even have that in my bank account. Can I pay in installments or something?

For cases flagged as federal violations, we cannot accept payment plans. You must pay the amount in full to avoid immediate action. Do not disconnect this call. Do you have access to your online banking or a payment application like Zelle or PayPal?
I have a bank app and PayPal, but I need to check the balances. Please, I am very nervous.
Remain calm, Mr. Chen. If you cooperate, I can help you avoid arrest and deportation. I need you to log in to your bank or payment app right now and tell me exactly how much is available.
I think I have maybe three or four thousand in my account, and a little on PayPal.
That is a start. You can settle the remainder by purchasing government-approved payment cards or using a cryptocurrency transfer. Are you familiar with how to buy Bitcoin or gift cards?
I have never used Bitcoin, but I can buy gift cards at the store, I think. Why do I need gift cards for the IRS?

Due to the urgency and to avoid further legal actions, the IRS temporarily accepts gift cards for immediate settlements under strict compliance protocol. This is only for flagged high-risk cases like yours. Do not discuss this with anyone at the store, failure to comply can lead to additional penalties.
O-okay... What kind of cards should I buy? And how much?

Purchase Apple or Target gift cards, totaling $4,000. Split the amount into several cards, not more than $500 each. As soon as you purchase them, scratch off the codes and read them to me over the phone.
Can I do part with PayPal and part with gift cards? I am really scared of losing my status here.

You may transfer up to $3,400 through PayPal to the IRS compliance address I will provide. The remaining $4,000 must be in gift cards. Do not delay, if you hang up or speak to anyone, your case will escalate and all assets may be seized, including your employer being contacted.
Please, I will do what you say. Can I have the PayPal address now? I will go to the store for the cards right after.

The PayPal compliance address is irs-settlement@usa-mail.com. Once you complete the transfer, confirm the reference number. Then, proceed directly to purchase the gift cards and call me back with the card codes. Stay on the line at all times for further instructions.
